question: Which lines of the template audit point at a document that has been read since the audit?
raw:
I can't answer this from what I have, and the reason is simple: no line in either audit points at a document read after it ran.

- **Both audits used the same readings.** The Oregon DEQ audit and the checklist audit (12-auditor-checklist-deq-air.docx) both ran on 2026-11-03. Both used readings as of 2026-10-14.
- **Every reading I can see is dated 2026-10-14.** That includes the scrubber log, the permit, the 2025 annual report, the Emergency Action Plan, the Monthly EHS Self-Check and the DEQ inspection form. Each one was read before the audits ran, so the audits saw them.

**Two caveats:**
- **The checklist file has no usable reading.** The list shows 12-auditor-checklist-deq-air.docx as Queued, and no summary was stored for it. I can't say whether it was read after the audit. If you meant that file when you said "template," the lines in it are the audit's own lines, not a document read later.
- **You may have meant the blank template.** That would be the Monthly EHS Self-Check, a blank internal template. It was read on 2026-10-14, before the Oregon DEQ audit, so the audit's finding on it (nothing on file, no completed monthly records) reflects that reading.

**Is anything newer than the audits?**
- **The list shows no change dates after 2026-10-14.** The last entry dates run to 2026-09-25 for the scrubber log. If you have re-filed or changed a document since 2026-10-14, my answer would rest on the older reading and could be out of date.
- **Re-running the audit would bring the lines up to date.**

Which "template" did you mean: the Monthly EHS Self-Check, or the DEQ checklist file? Either way, I can propose a fresh Oregon DEQ audit.
